title: Professional Certificate Course in AI and Robotics
description: To equip learners with the knowledge and practical understanding of Artificial Intelligence and robotics for designing, implementing, and managing intelligent automated systems.
longDescription: Explain the fundamental concepts, principles, and components of Artificial Intelligence and robotics. Analyze the role of AI technologies in enabling intelligent robotic perception, learning, and autonomous decision-making. Evaluate the applications of AI-powered robotics across industrial, healthcare, agricultural, logistics, and service environments. Assess the ethical, legal, safety, and societal implications of deploying intelligent robotic systems. Demonstrate an understanding of emerging trends and best practices in AI-driven robotics and automation. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and robotics in modern industries and society. It explores intelligent robotic systems, machine learning, computer vision, automation, and autonomous decision-making. Learners will examine the design, deployment, and applications of AI-powered robots across manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, agriculture, and service sectors. The course also addresses ethical, legal, and safety considerations associated with intelligent robotic technologies.
